Author: Serpens66
Name: Unit Costs
Description: Configure recruit costs in Stronghold Crusader Definitive Edition.

Changes: Updated the mod for Script Extender 2.2.0.
Keep engineer-built siege engines at their Vanilla gold costs when configured as unchanged and restore modified costs immediately when the mod is disabled.
Generate Portable PDB debug symbols for Unity Mono-compatible stack traces and debugging.
Adds standalone support for the shared Script Extender per-player identity workaround.
fix game localization
Tooltip size test.
Isolated native gold costs, extra costs, enforcement, and optional UI hooks, with per-unit apply and restore failure handling.
Disabled custom recruitment-cost UI, validation, and extra-resource deductions in the map editor.
Made unit gold costs and extra resource costs directly editable beyond compact slider ranges; gold now supports -10000 through 10000 and other resources 0 through 100.
Prevented clients from persisting or retransmitting host-only extra-cost normalization after synchronized native gold-cost changes.
Added temporary Script Extender compatibility fixes for multiplayer settings synchronization during lobby joins, reliable lobby delivery, and authenticated in-game host updates.
Updated shared lobby settings for Script Extender 1.42.0 by avoiding redundant UI-only persistence and using the official multiplayer-game signal.
Added optional Serps Mods Host dependency for Workshop mod-pack load ordering.
Updated shared files
Highlighted the activation control and standardized larger, wider settings tooltips.
Clarified base and additional cost sections and added opaque, automatically wrapping tooltips.
Delegated optional mission-preset coordination to CustomCustomTrail; local presets remain standalone.
Added mission-bound Trail presets from .modjson and CustomCustomTrail schema-2 missions, including shared customization UI.
Added two automatically saved lobby-settings presets with migration of existing settings to preset 1.
Play -recruits are missing- if this is the reason for not being able to recruit
Do not highlight units as recruitable if extra costs are missing.
Also display current amounts of extra costs in tooltip
Removed support to change vanilla material costs of european units for everyone, because I think the extra costs for humans is enough and it makes this mod less complicated.
